name: What information should I provide to my luxury buyer's agent?

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide to my luxury buyer's agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure your agent can effectively represent you, you should provide detailed information regarding your desired property type, size, preferred architectural styles, and must-have amenities. Disclose your budget range, financing pre-approval status, and any specific timelines or relocation needs. It's also helpful to share your priorities for communities, whether it's the vibrant energy of Brickell or the quiet exclusivity of Pinecrest. Clear communication about your non-negotiables and aspirations allows for a more targeted and efficient property search.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide details on property type, size, style, amenities, budget, financing, timelines, and preferred communities to help your agent find the best match.
